title: Has Anyone Received Their Velocity 20% Bonus on Auto-Redemption Offer (May/June 2024) ?
body:
There was a Velocity bonus 20% offer for auto redemption. Terms and conditions said points would arrive 31/07/2024 (yesterday).
Still haven't received the bonus points. Anyone got theirs?
I transferred from ANZ reward points to Velocity.
Edit: Just received mine today.
